items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The name 'Nancy' appears only in the interviewer's turn ('Go ahead, Nancy') as a cue for another speaker. The interviewee does not mention Nancy, nor does the transcript provide any information about the interviewee's relationship with Nancy.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wonder why you didn't want to take him to California too.

No, he had quit playing. He was playing guitar when I left there. Oh really? Then he went back to the drum. I was so old and he couldn't make it. He just got away from it. Go ahead, Nancy. Nah, go ahead. Thanks.

So, alright. We started playing that night, playing all them numbers and you know Wade had a habit when he was talking. Y'all used to call him Busher. So, alright. He said, you know something? Man, if I had a lineup like this, go to California, Cali. Cali, we clean up. I said, let me tell you, a white band right around the corner of my house. He was begging for a band. I'm there. Oh man.
